The long body is built from broad overlapping armoured plates, like a segmented carapace, with a ridge of short gripping spurs along each flank that brace against the corridor walls; the skin is dark mottled leathery hide with pale rubbery seams, no snake bands and no scale pattern.

The coil is one fixed shape in every facing: a wide low symmetric arch of body about 320 px across, with the same thickness and bulk, built from the same three stacked loops of plated body.

The north view is the rear of that same wide arch: the plated back, the spur ridge and the blunt anchoring tail paddle face the viewer at the same width and bulk as the south view, and the head is tucked out of sight behind the coil.

heavy blunt ambush head
corridor-hugging coiled resting posture
dormant resting pose, single creature centred, whole body visible
pouchy lips and velvety skin quality from the previous render

request.prompt: A creature sprite for RimWorld: the yanker, an invented alien corridor predator. A long, low ambush hunter built for a tunnel: it lies dormant, coiled in a wide, low, symmetric arch of three stacked loops about 320 px across, wedged into one narrow gap, and it wakes only when prey comes within touching distance. Anatomy: a heavy blunt wedge of a head with a wide hinged mouth ringed by thick pouchy lip-flaps and short hooked grasping palps at the jaw corners, small recessed eyes under bony brow ridges. The long limbless body is built from broad overlapping armoured plates like a segmented carapace, dark mottled leathery hide with pale rubbery seams and a velvety sheen, and a ridge of short gripping spurs along each flank that brace against corridor walls. The tail ends in a thick blunt anchoring paddle with a cluster of hooked grip-spurs. Colour: deep olive-brown hide, pale rubbery seams, darker plates. The coil has identical width, thickness and bulk in every facing. Front view: eyes toward the viewer, head resting on top of the coil. Side view: profile of the head resting on the coil, spur ridge visible. Rear view, seen from behind: the plated back, spur ridge and anchoring tail paddle face the viewer at the same wide arch and bulk as the front view, head hidden behind the coil. Realistic painterly vanilla RimWorld sprite style, clean dark outline with soft painted edges in a deeper shade of the local colour. Exactly ONE creature, centred, the whole body visible with nothing cut off. Fully transparent background: no ground, no water, no shadow, no text, no border.
